text: The U.S. financial corporations subject to N/DPAs collectively exceed $690 billion in market capitalization and more than $20 trillion in assets under management, making N/DPA governance intervention economically consequential.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Timothy Lacine, Stock Price Response to Non- and Deferred Prosecution Agreements (2015). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2629451

isBasedOn.name: Stock Price Response to Non- and Deferred Prosecution Agreements

abstract: The collective market capitalization of U.S. financial corporations that are subject to NDPAs exceeds $690 billion and exceeds over $20 trillion in assets under management (Copland 2012).

value: U.S. financial corporations subject to N/DPAs as of the Copland 2012 count
